selection_status: Champion claim withdrawn; no automatic promotion. Availability audit is a derived diagnostic, not an official grade.

series_definitions.reference_diagnostic: Available supervision with explicit review exclusions. Unreviewed silver remains a source-A diagnostic, never independent truth.
series_definitions.qualified_development: Exclude unreviewed silver lithology/ARI/product and Hadrian unQA. Silver contacts remain source-A contact diagnostics. QA/gold and supplied DEV retain development/exposure caveats; no unexposed-well or human-truth certification is implied for DEV.

method.mean: Equal physical-log mean of available window metrics; overall precedence QA > gold > eval > DEV; Hadrian unQA separate.
method.product: Per-window row accuracy times boundary F1. Null if row accuracy unavailable. Failed predictions with valid supervision stay zero.
method.paired: Exact same cases, then common available log means; deterministic10,000 log bootstrap draws, seed1108. No inference or truth correction.
method.depth: Finite in-window GT boundary depth required; no matched finite prediction depth is unavailable, never zero MAE.
